paragraphs.text: Kirin (KEE-rihn) is creature type for a chimeric species with the aspects of Horse , Dragon , and Deer or Goat . They always have flying - legends say that the kirin walked upon clouds to avoid ever harming another being. Kirin are omens of good fortune and long life. A kirin is said to appear with the imminent arrival or passing of a wise sage or an illustrious ruler.
With the exception of the Kamigawa cycle, all Kirins are aligned with white mana.
The kirin creature type based on the Qilin or Kirin from Eastern Asian folklore.
Kirin first appeared in Saviors of Kamigawa featured them in a cycle of five legendary kirin.
Kirin returned in the Tarkir block without the spirit type. Khans of Tarkir included Alabaster Kirin and Dragons of Tarkir introduced Misthoof Kirin .
Global Series: Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling printed Heavenly Qilin . For this Chinese inspired set, the design team used "Qilin", the traditional Pinyin transliteration of the Mandarin.
Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty featured Cloudsteel Kirin and Hinata, Dawn-Crowned . Cloudsteel Kirin is an artifact creature and the first Kamigawan kirin that is not a kami.
Kirin can be found on Kamigawa , Shenmeng , and Tarkir . While Kamigawan kirin are kami and possess the spirit subtype, the kirin of Shenmeng and Tarkir are not spirits.
Kamigawan kirin appear to be a type of kami .

Five kirin kami each representing one of the colors of mana are known to every 1,000 years. During one such meeting they discussed whether or not they should intervene in the ongoing Kami War with each sharing their experiences observing mortals to support their position.

When the Orochi were cut off from their ancestral homeland, they appealed to the kami for help. In the end, it was the kirin who answered that call. But the kirin refused to become the orochi's new patron, as they first requested. Instead, through a series of tasks and quests, the kirin helped the orochi understand the truth behind their loss of power.
On Shenmeng , qilin are said to have been birthed by the Ancestor Dragon .
Tarkiri kirin lived on the plane in both the Khans timeline and Dragons timeline. They are still present on the plane during the Omenpath Era , following the birth of the Spirit Dragons .
